entities.summary: Edvaldo Gonçalves Amaral S.D.B. is a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate who served as the archbishop of the Archdiocese of Maceió from 1985 until his retirement in 2002. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop and as Bishop of Parnaíba.
